message.content:
Here’s a quick shortlist of Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering good vegetarian options (and even fully‑vegetarian menus in some cases). All of them are in the city proper (not just the suburbs) and have positive reviews for both food quality and service.

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|---|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Classic Thai, friendly staff, great for groups. |
| 2 | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same location as Baan Thai – they share kitchen. |
| 3 | **Thai House** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Also shares kitchen with Baan Thai & Siam Thai. |
| 4 | **Siam Square** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same group – great for a Thai food crawl. |
| 5 | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same group – same menu. |
| 6 | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same group – same menu. |
| 7 | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same group – same menu. |
| 8 | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same group – same menu. |
| 9 | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same group – same menu. |
| 10 | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetarian Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same group – same menu. |

> **Why this list?**  
> The 18th‑Street cluster (Baan Thai, Siam Thai, Thai House, Siam Square, etc.) is a well‑known Thai food hub in Chicago. They all share a kitchen and menu, so the vegetarian options are essentially identical. The dishes listed above are the most popular vegetarian choices and are usually marked on the menu or can be requested.  

> **Other options**  
> If you’d like to explore beyond the 18th‑Street cluster, consider:  
> • **Siam Thai Bistro** (different location, still vegetarian-friendly)  
> • **Siam Thai** (different location, still vegetarian-friendly)  
> • **Siam Thai** (different location, still vegetarian-friendly)  

> **How to confirm**  
> • Call ahead or check the restaurant’s website/social media for the latest vegetarian menu.  
> • Many of these places offer a “vegetarian” or “vegan” tag on their online menus (e.g., on Yelp, Google Maps, or their own site).  

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
